diagnosis: The endpoint accepts portfolioId from req.body and dispatches an inter-process communication (IPC) task to rebalance quantitative trading allocations across worker processes. It never verifies that req.trader.accountId matches the owner of portfolioId, allowing malicious traders to alter investment allocations and liquidate assets in other investors' accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/trading/rebalance HTTP/1.1
Host: quant.brokerage.io
Authorization: Bearer <trader_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"portfolioId": "pf_institutional_9901", "targetModelWeightings": {"US_EQUITIES": 0.0, "CRYPTO_HIGH_RISK": 1.0}}
